slices.title: Record v2: per-model limits and lifecycle
slices.summary: Adds a static per-model table in inference-core (context window, max output, lifecycle ga|preview|deprecated) with a vendor source comment per row; unknown models stay 0/empty. Proto ModelInfo gains context_window_tokens=9, max_output_tokens=10, lifecycle=11 (EP-9 C5 takes data_use=12 after). Fields flow through grpc.rs and /v1/models (skipped when unknown) and the SPA shows context chip, preview chip and an 'Eldre modeller' fold for deprecated. Provider ceilings clamp the table (Foundry stays 8192 output). No flag: read-only metadata, state this in the PR.

slices.title: Docked step strip and tool narration
